prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Miami for hurricane-rated roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t an objective single “best,” but **Art’s Roofing & Construction** looks like a strong option to put on your shortlist for a Miami-Dade hurricane-rated replacement. Its published information says it holds Florida roofing license **CCC1333598**, serves Miami-Dade, and installs roof systems to the area’s High-Velocity Hurricane Zone (HVHZ) requirements. [Company details](https://www.artsroofing.com/) · [Hurricane roofing information](https://www.artsroofing.com/best-roofing-contractor-miami/)

Before choosing, get at least three written bids and verify each contractor’s active license and insurance. Ask for the exact roofing system and Miami-Dade approval (NOA) or applicable Florida Product Approval, permit and inspection plan, deck-replacement pricing, and written workmanship and manufacturer warranties. A “hurricane-rated” claim alone doesn’t establish how the complete roof assembly will perform.
